public_body: Everett School Committee On Finance And Negotiation
overall: The AG found the Subcommittee violated the OML by holding the June 7 and June 13 executive session meetings in an inaccessible building, found no violation for the cancelled May 16 meeting, and ordered release of the minutes and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the May 16 Subcommittee meeting was not accessible to the public.
allegations.key_passage: cancelled and therefore the Subcommittee did not violate the Open Meeting Law wi th respect to this meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the June 7 executive session meeting was held in the Central Administration Building, which was not accessible to persons with disabilities.
allegations.key_passage: Nevertheless, we find that the Subcommittee violated the Open Meeting Law by holding meetings in a location that was not accessible.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the June 13 executive session meeting was held in the Central Administration Building, which was not accessible to persons with disabilities.
allegations.key_passage: Nevertheless, we find that the Subcommittee violated the Open Meeting Law by holding meetings in a location that was not accessible.

remedy: Release to the public the June 7 and June 13 executive session meeting minutes, if not already released, without any redaction or withholding.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
